Bruiser's pork and sage sausage rolls
Bruiser, Elle's chihuahua, who goes everywhere in her handbag

Pork mince with onion, sage and a little apple rolled in flaky puff pastry, sesame on top, baked golden and served with tomato relish. Heat the oven to 200C. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 finely chopped onion, 1 grated apple, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Cut 2 thawed puff pastry sheets in half, lay a sausage of filling along each, roll up and seal with beaten egg. Cut into 4cm pieces, brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake on a lined tray for 20 to 25 minutes until golden. Serve warm with tomato relish.

M: Elle's first term at Harvard Law
Chicken strips seared, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes added with cream, spinach wilted through, tossed with penne and parmesan.
Harvard clam chowder in cob loaves
Elle's move to Boston for Harvard Law

Bacon, onion and potato simmered with clams, milk and cream into a thick New England chowder, ladled into hollowed cob loaves with crackers. Fry 150g diced bacon in a pot until crisp. Add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml fish stock, 400ml milk and 500g diced potato. Simmer 15 minutes until the potato is tender. Add 1kg clams (vongole) and cook covered for 5 minutes until open, then pick out the shells. Stir in 150ml cream, thyme and pepper. Hollow out 4 small cob loaves and ladle the chowder in.

K: Elle Woods and her love of all things pink
Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup stirred with crushed raspberries and cold water, strained and poured over ice.

s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate with a drop of pink colouring and drizzle all over. Sprinkle with sea salt flakes and leave to set, then break into clusters. Very pink.
Melt 200g white chocolate. Dip 250g strawberries halfway and roll in pink sprinkles straight away. Set on baking paper for 15 minutes. Serve at the salon while explaining the rules of hair care.

m.note: Elle's first term at Harvard Law
m.how: Sear 2 sliced chicken breasts, add crushed garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes, then 300ml cream. Wilt 100g spinach through. Toss with 500g cooked penne and parmesan. What, like it's hard?

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and lemon zest, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat butter and icing sugar with crushed raspberries until pink and pipe on top.

d.note: Elle Woods and her love of all things pink
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Crush 125g raspberries in a jug with the juice of 6 lemons, the syrup and 1.5L cold water, then strain. Pour over ice in pink glasses if you have them.
